failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when inputs are non-finite, shape-incompatible, or violate nonnegativity constraints.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError when the diagnostic produces a non-finite result.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; a rejected call produces no result.
